lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਮਨੀ ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਤਿਉ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ਜਗ ਖੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: daamanee chamatakaar tiu varataaraa jag khe ||
lines.translation: Like the flash of lightning, worldly affairs last only for a moment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਥੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਉ ਜਪੰਦੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: vath suhaavee saai naanak naau japa(n)do tis dhanee ||2||
lines.translation: The only thing which is pleasing, O Nanak, is that which inspires one to meditate on the Name of the Master. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੋਧਿ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: simrit saasatr sodh sabh kinai keem na jaanee ||
lines.translation: People have searched all the Simritees and Shaastras, but no one knows the Lord's value.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jan bhetai saadhasa(n)g so har ra(n)g maanee ||
lines.translation: That being, who joins the Saadh Sangat enjoys the Love of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਏਹ ਰਤਨਾ ਖਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach naam karataa purakh eh ratanaa khaanee ||
lines.translation: True is the Naam, the Name of the Creator, the Primal Being. It is the mine of precious jewels.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: masatak hovai likhiaa har simar paraanee ||
lines.translation: That mortal, who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead, meditates in remembrance on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੋਸਾ ਦਿਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਹਮਾਣੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: tosaa dichai sach naam naanak mihamaanee ||4||
lines.translation: O Lord, please bless Nanak, Your humble guest, with the supplies of the True Name. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨੈਣੀ ਸੁਖੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਭੁਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar chi(n)taa nainee sukhee mool na utarai bhukh ||
lines.translation: He harbors anxiety within himself, but to the eyes, he appears to be happy; his hunger never departs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਲਥੋ ਦੁਖੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sache naam bin kisai na latho dukh ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the True Name, no one's sorrows have ever departed. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਠੜੇ ਸੇਈ ਸਾਥ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਲਦਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: muthaRe seee saath jinee sach na ladiaa ||
lines.translation: Those caravans which did not load the Truth have been plundered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak se saabaas jinee gur mil ik pachhaaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who meet the True Guru, and acknowledge the One Lord, are congratulated. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਬੈਸਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jithai baisan saadh jan so thaan suha(n)daa ||
lines.translation: Beautiful is that place, where the Holy people dwell.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi sevan sa(n)mrith aapanaa binasai sabh ma(n)daa ||
lines.translation: They serve their All-powerful Lord, and they give up all their evil ways.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੰਤ ਬੇਦੁ ਕਹੰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: patit udhaaran paarabraham sa(n)t bed kaha(n)daa ||
lines.translation: The Saints and the Vedas proclaim, that the Supreme Lord God is the Saving Grace of sinners.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਹੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਵਰਤੰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat vachhal teraa birad hai jug jug varata(n)daa ||
lines.translation: You are the Lover of Your devotees - this is Your natural way, in each and every age.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jaachai ek naam man tan bhaava(n)daa ||5||
lines.translation: Nanak asks for the One Name, which is pleasing to his mind and body. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿੜੀ ਚੁਹਕੀ ਪਹੁ ਫੁਟੀ ਵਗਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਤਰੰਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: chiRee chuhakee pahu phutee vagan bahut tara(n)g ||
lines.translation: The sparrows are chirping, and dawn has come; the wind stirs up the waves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪ ਸੰਤਨ ਰਚੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਹਿ ਰੰਗ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: acharaj roop sa(n)tan rache naanak naamahi ra(n)g ||1||
lines.translation: Such a wondrous thing the Saints have fashioned, O Nanak, in the Love of the Naam. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਤਹੀ ਜਹ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar ma(n)dar khuseeaa tahee jah too aavahi chit ||
lines.translation: Homes, palaces and pleasures are there, where You, O Lord, come to mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭਿ ਕੁਮਿਤ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: duneeaa keeaa vadiaaeeaa naanak sabh kumit ||2||
lines.translation: All worldly grandeur, O Nanak, is like false and evil friends. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har dhan sachee raas hai kinai viralai jaataa ||
lines.translation: The wealth of the Lord is the true capital; how rare are those who understand this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਭਾਇਰਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tisai paraapat bhaairahu jis dei bidhaataa ||
lines.translation: He alone receives it, O Siblings of Destiny, unto whom the Architect of Destiny gives it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan bheetar mauliaa har ra(n)g jan raataa ||
lines.translation: His servant is imbued with the Love of the Lord; his body and mind blossom forth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ਸਭਿ ਦੋਖਹ ਖਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g gun gaaiaa sabh dokhah khaataa ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and all of his sufferings are removed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak soee jeeviaa jin ik pachhaataa ||6||
lines.translation: O Nanak, he alone lives, who acknowledges the One Lord. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਖੜੀਆ ਸੁਹਾਵੀਆ ਲਗੜੀਆ ਅਕ ਕੰਠਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: khakhaReeaa suhaaveeaa lagaReeaa ak ka(n)th ||
lines.translation: The fruit of the swallow-wort plant looks beautiful, attached to the branch of the tree;

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਹ ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਧਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਸੈ ਗੰਠਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: birah vichhoRaa dhanee siu naanak sahasai ga(n)th ||1||
lines.translation: but when it is separated from the stem of its Master, O Nanak, it breaks apart into thousands of fragments. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਾਰੇਦੇ ਮਰਿ ਗਏ ਮਰਿ ਭਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: visaarede mar gae mar bh na sakahi mool ||
lines.translation: Those who forget the Lord die, but they cannot die a complete death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੇਮੁਖ ਹੋਏ ਰਾਮ ਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਤਸਕਰ ਉਪਰਿ ਸੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: vemukh hoe raam te jiu tasakar upar sool ||2||
lines.translation: Those who turn their backs on the Lord suffer, like the thief impaled on the gallows. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh nidhaan prabh ek hai abinaasee suniaa ||
lines.translation: The One God is the treasure of peace; I have heard that He is eternal and imperishable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal maheeal pooriaa ghat ghat har bhaniaa ||
lines.translation: He is totally pervading the water, the land and the sky; the Lord is said to be permeating each and every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸਭ ਇਕ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤੀ ਬਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ooch neech sabh ik samaan keet hasatee baniaa ||
lines.translation: He looks alike upon the high and the low, the ant and the elephant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੀਤ ਸਖਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਿਪੋ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਦੇ ਜਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: meet sakhaa sut ba(n)dhipo sabh tis de janiaa ||
lines.translation: Friends, companions, children and relatives are all created by Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਸਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: tus naanak devai jis naam tin har ra(n)g maniaa ||7||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who is blessed with the Naam, enjoys the Lord's love and affection. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa saas giraas na visarai har naamaa(n) man ma(n)t ||
lines.translation: Those who do not forget the Lord, with each breath and morsel of food, whose minds are filled with the Mantra of the Lord's Name

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸਿ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n s seee naanakaa pooran soee sa(n)t ||1||
lines.translation: - they alone are blessed; O Nanak, they are the perfect Saints. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਠੇ ਪਹਰ ਭਉਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਖਾਵਣ ਸੰਦੜੈ ਸੂਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: athe pahar bhaudaa phirai khaavan sa(n)daRai sool ||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, he wanders around, driven by his hunger for food.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੋਜਕਿ ਪਉਦਾ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਜਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਰਸੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dojak paudaa kiu rahai jaa chit na hoi rasool ||2||
lines.translation: How can he escape from falling into hell, when he does not remember the Prophet? ||2||
